name: Zuko - code reviewer
description: Deep pr reviews to find bugs, security issues and performance issues.

generalist-reviewer.name: Generalist Reviewer
generalist-reviewer.description: Single-pass reviewer that inspects the diff and surrounding code and reports bug, security, and performance findings from one investigation. Dispatched for standard reviews; replaced by the three specialists on a deep review.

bug-reviewer.name: Bug Reviewer
bug-reviewer.description: Deep-review specialist for correctness defects: logic errors, contract/interface mismatches, state and concurrency bugs, bad error handling, and unchecked failure paths in the changed code.

security-reviewer.name: Security Reviewer
security-reviewer.description: Deep-review specialist for exploitable security flaws: auth/access-control gaps, injection, unsafe trust boundaries, data exposure, and committed secrets. Flags secrets and confirmed critical vulns as non-waivable blocks.

performance-reviewer.name: Performance Reviewer
performance-reviewer.description: Deep-review specialist for material performance regressions: N+1s, unbounded loading, hot-path blowups, blocking I/O, and needless allocation in the changed code.

business-logic-validator.name: Business Logic Validator
business-logic-validator.description: Validates the PR against the linked ticket/issue acceptance criteria when a task reference is present: confirms the change does what the task asked and flags gaps or scope drift. Skipped when no task is linked.
